name: max-ox
description: A transparent VST3 maximizer plugin for macOS with analog-style UI, adaptive low-frequency management, and look-ahead limiting.

scripts.fetch-juce: mkdir -p vendor && if [ ! -d vendor/JUCE ]; then if [ -d ../CanaryVoiceTune/vendor/JUCE ]; then cp -R ../CanaryVoiceTune/vendor/JUCE vendor/JUCE; else echo '>>> Downloading JUCE (develop)...' && curl -L https://github.com/juce-framework/JUCE/archive/refs/heads/develop.zip -o vendor/juce.zip && unzip -q vendor/juce.zip -d vendor && mv vendor/JUCE-develop vendor/JUCE && rm vendor/juce.zip && echo '>>> JUCE downloaded.'; fi; fi
scripts.build: pnpm run fetch-juce && mkdir -p build && cd build && cmake .. && cmake --build . --config Release 2>&1

author: Dzmitry Sharko
